dataset.name: Maldonado, Shihab and Tsantalis SATD comment dataset (IEEE TSE 2017)

metadata.license: The dataset is published without a license file as research data accompanying the paper; it is used for training only and is not redistributed, and only the derived weights are shipped. Cite: E. da S. Maldonado, E. Shihab, N.
